authority: Codex design reviews/2026-10-17_row19_resize_codex.md (RSC 08ce9e3) s.2-4 and s.6 item 4; owner adoption 17 Oct 2026 (chpc/ROW19_SCREEN_DECLARATIONS.md, final section; RSC 58b7b78); PREREGISTRATION_T1_model.md s.10.1 amendment (RSC 5bc33f0). Pinned in chpc/row19_screen_controls.json version 16; a changed copy HOLDS every refit admission.
rule: S = {r in 3..102 : (r - 3) mod 5 in {0, 1, 2}}; ID-only, never by success, runtime, interval or score; rep 83 included
order: replicate-complete: ascending rep within S, ascending index within a rep; skip validated DONE, every still-owned live/planned coordinate, crash-excluded coordinates and another provider's partition block

providers.rule: Lengau plans every designated coordinate of lengau_reps, plus the designated coordinates of ec2_reps it has ALREADY claimed (ever planned, any ledger state); the UNCLAIMED designated coordinates of ec2_reps wait for the separate EC2 provider-epoch package (explicit coordinate-set ownership) and are never planned by Lengau. The epoch-1 partition (EC2: indices 160..199) stays pinned and enforced.

crash_rule.counted: crashed-worker slot dispositions (REVISION 14: a planned worker killed by its own fatal signal - Segmentation fault, Bus error, Aborted, Illegal instruction - before any status) carried by the newest gate receipt, which the admission recomputes exactly; one attempt per (job, coordinate); same envelope = queue, cores, walltime, mem, nodetype and deadline reserve of the job's resolved request
crash_rule.consequence: the ordinary planner never issues a third identical attempt; the coordinate is RESCUE-PENDING (reported by the dry run and the status view) and stays missing until the rescue route admits it; never replaced, never dropped from S

rescue.note: s.3/s.4: one prospective, budgeted rescue lane, two full 1,152 core-h reservations inside the 81,000 sub-envelope; same dataset/seed/folds/index/start policy/numerical environment, lower packing and larger measured headroom, with parity/resource qualification and retained attempt provenance. No host, packing or envelope is chosen here; enabling it is a separate reviewed amendment.

scaleup_rule: s.4: the first prospective Lengau job under the new order is admitted alone; scale-up needs gate/scaleup_refit_v16.json from a tracked review record carrying ADOPT row19-screen-v16-scaleup first_job=<n> job_id=<pbs id> plan=<sha256>
